description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint class for retrieving a catalog item by its ID in the eShopOnWeb project. It includes route mapping, handling the request and response, and interacting with a repository to fetch the catalog item data.

classes.name: CatalogItemGetByIdEndpoint
classes.description: Defines a minimal API endpoint for fetching a catalog item by ID, implementing route setup and request handling.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the API route for GET requests to fetch catalog items by ID.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the request to retrieve a catalog item and constructs the appropriate response.
